parameters.formDescription: Upload the provided 10-request CSV to generate posts, or a reviewed Evaluation Log CSV to judge saved posts. Each request must include an Approved facts: section. Generation keeps existing posts; use blank Model_Output cells for a new run.

parameters.content:
## Social media evaluation
Generate 10 posts, then mark PASS or FAIL for Factual Correctness, Clarity, Value / Insight, Engagement and Tone Fit. The workbook calculates Overall: all five PASS = PASS; any FAIL = FAIL.

Attach OpenRouter Header Auth (Authorization: Bearer <OpenRouter API key>) to Generate Post and Independent LLM Review. Call Jev uses its own TypeSafe Header Auth (Authorization: Bearer <TypeSafe API key>). Never put keys in Code nodes.

Generation exports request ID, brief and post for Evaluation Log. Keep original posts and reviews; reruns go to Revised Posts. Judge results contain one row per dimension plus Overall and belong in Judge. Judges never receive human labels or each other's answers. Failed calls are not quality FAILs. See docs/walkthrough.md.
